name: Diagnose a spatial error
when: The repair task indicates or visually suggests an invalid spatial relationship.
procedure: Identify the involved objects and boundaries from permitted views.
Distinguish collision or boundary errors from orientation errors under the task-specific rules.
When visual overlap is ambiguous, compare available views before selecting an object or transformation.
verification: The diagnosis identifies the affected entities and the evidence for the error type.
failure_lessons: Image overlap alone does not prove geometric intersection; do not invent semantic orientation rules.
adaptation_notes: Adapts Boundary Analysis to SpatialAct error categories using public evidence only.
